parameters.query:
SELECT
  a.id            AS application_id,
  a.user_id       AS candidate_user_id,
  a.restaurant_id AS restaurant_id,
  a.position_id   AS position_id,
  a.answers       AS answers,
  p.name          AS name,
  p.city          AS city,
  p.experience    AS experience,
  p.shifts        AS cand_shifts,
  p.languages     AS languages,
  p.position_types AS cand_positions,
  p.min_hourly_rate AS min_hourly_rate,
  p.phone         AS phone,
  rp.name         AS position_name,
  rp.hourly_rate  AS hourly_rate,
  rp.shifts       AS pos_shifts,
  rp.requirements AS requirements,
  r.name          AS restaurant_name,
  r.mandatory_shifts AS mandatory_shifts,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(q ORDER BY q.sort_order)
    FROM position_screening_questions q
    WHERE q.position_id = a.position_id AND q.enabled
  ), '[]'::json) AS questions
FROM applications a
JOIN profiles p     ON p.id = a.user_id
LEFT JOIN restaurant_positions rp ON rp.id = a.position_id
JOIN restaurants r  ON r.id = a.restaurant_id
WHERE a.id = $1;
